ISBAR.TITLE: ISBAR Nursing Handover (General Staff)
ISBAR.I_TITLE: I - Identity (Who am I, who are you talking to)
ISBAR.MY_NAME_PLACEHOLDER: Example: I am Xiao Ming's daughter Zhang Xiao Mei, his primary caregiver.
ISBAR.RECEIVER_NAME_PLACEHOLDER: Example: I am talking to Nurse Chen, she is the day shift nurse at the hospital.
ISBAR.PATIENT_INFO_PLACEHOLDER: Example: This is my father Li Xiao Ming, 65 years old, male.
ISBAR.S_TITLE: S - Situation (What is the current situation)
ISBAR.CURRENT_ISSUE_PLACEHOLDER: Example: Dad started having severe chest pain at 8 am today, and is sweating a lot.
ISBAR.ISSUE_TIME_LABEL: Time or cause of the issue:
ISBAR.ISSUE_TIME_PLACEHOLDER: Example: The issue started suddenly at 8 am, we don't know why, but he was a bit tired before.
ISBAR.ISSUE_STABILITY_PLACEHOLDER: Example: His heart rate is very fast, his face looks pale, it feels urgent, needs immediate check.
ISBAR.HEALTH_HISTORY_PLACEHOLDER: Example: Dad has high blood pressure, heart problems, and diabetes, had heart surgery before.
ISBAR.RECENT_TREATMENT_PLACEHOLDER: Example: He takes blood pressure and diabetes medicine every day, took heart medicine yesterday.
ISBAR.RECENT_CHECKUP_PLACEHOLDER: Example: The doctor said yesterday his heart checkup had some issues, blood tests showed abnormalities.
ISBAR.A_TITLE: A - Assessment (What do I think about this issue)
ISBAR.MY_OBSERVATION_PLACEHOLDER: Example: I think Dad's chest pain might be heart discomfort because he had a similar situation before.
ISBAR.POSSIBLE_CAUSE_PLACEHOLDER: Example: It might be because he was too tired yesterday, or the medicine is not working well.
ISBAR.SEVERITY_PLACEHOLDER: Example: I think it's very severe because he looks in pain, and his blood pressure is low.
ISBAR.R_TITLE: R - Recommendation (What help do I need)
ISBAR.RECOMMENDATION_PLACEHOLDER: Example: I want to call a doctor immediately to check his heart and see if there's a problem.
ISBAR.ASSISTANCE_NEEDED_LABEL: What assistance or items are needed:
ISBAR.ASSISTANCE_NEEDED_PLACEHOLDER: Example: We need an oxygen machine to help him breathe, or ask the doctor to bring heart medicine.
ISBAR.FOLLOW_UP_LABEL: What to pay attention to next:
ISBAR.FOLLOW_UP_PLACEHOLDER: Example: Please check his condition every 15 minutes, if the chest pain worsens, call me or the doctor immediately.
